_about: Short form cues for common lifts, written for BodySync in plain language. Cues describe what to do to the bar, the floor or the body (the research favours that over 'squeeze this muscle'). General coaching, not medical advice.

cues: Pull the bar apart and tuck your shoulder blades back and down
Keep your feet planted and push the floor away
Lower to your lower chest, then press up in a slight arc toward your eyes
Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip.watch: Bouncing the bar off your chest, or your hips lifting off the bench.
Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip.feel: Chest, front of the shoulders, back of the arms
Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip.easier: Push-ups, or dumbbells with lighter weight. Use safety arms or a spotter.

cues: Spread the floor apart with your feet
Sit down between your hips, knees tracking over your toes
Stand up by pushing the floor away, chest tall
Barbell Squat.watch: Heels lifting, knees collapsing inward, or your lower back rounding at the bottom.
Barbell Squat.easier: Bodyweight squats or a box squat.

cues: Pull the slack out of the bar before it leaves the floor
Push the floor away instead of yanking with your back
Stand tall at the top; don't lean back
Barbell Deadlift.watch: Rounding your back, or the bar drifting away from your legs.
Barbell Deadlift.feel: Glutes, hamstrings and the whole back
Barbell Deadlift.easier: Romanian deadlifts with lighter weight, or a kettlebell deadlift.

cues: Push your hips back as if closing a car door with them
Keep the bar sliding down your legs
Stop when you feel a stretch behind your thighs
Romanian Deadlift.watch: Rounding your back, or bending your knees into a squat.
Romanian Deadlift.easier: Dumbbells or a lighter bar, shorter range.

cues: Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down
Press the bar straight up and move your head through at the top
Keep the bar over the middle of your foot
Barbell Shoulder Press.watch: Leaning back to muscle the weight up.
Barbell Shoulder Press.easier: Seated dumbbell press with lighter weight.

cues: Hinge forward and keep your torso still
Pull the bar to your belly button, elbows toward your back pockets
Lower the bar slowly
Bent Over Barbell Row.watch: Swinging your torso to move the weight.
Bent Over Barbell Row.feel: Back, back of the shoulders, front of the arms
Bent Over Barbell Row.easier: Inverted rows or a chest-supported row.

cues: Keep your hips and lower back flat on the seat
Push through your whole foot
Stop just short of locking your knees
Leg Press.watch: Hips curling off the seat at the bottom, or knees falling inward.
Leg Press.easier: Lighter weight or a shorter range of motion.

cues: Keep your elbows pinned by your sides
Lift the bar up, then lower it slowly
Stay tall; don't swing your back
Barbell Curl.watch: Rocking your torso to cheat the bar up.

cues: Pull your elbows down toward your back pockets
Lean back a little and lift your chest to the bar
Let the bar rise under control
Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown.watch: Yanking the bar with momentum, or pulling it behind your neck.
Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown.feel: Sides of the back, front of the arms
Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown.easier: Lighter weight, or use a resistance band.

cues: Stay upright with your elbows pointing back
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor
Press the handles down to rise
Dips - Triceps Version.watch: Shoulders rolling forward, or dropping lower than feels comfortable.

cues: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down
Push through your heels
Squeeze your glutes at the top and pause
Barbell Hip Thrust.watch: Arching your lower back at the top instead of using your glutes.
Barbell Hip Thrust.easier: Glute bridge on the floor, no weight.

cues: Take a long step and drop straight down
Keep your front knee over your middle toes
Push through the front heel to stand
Barbell Lunge.watch: Front knee caving in, or leaning forward.
Barbell Lunge.easier: Split squats holding a wall or post.

cues: Start from a full hang with your shoulders pulled down
Pull your elbows toward your ribs
Get your chin over the bar, then lower with control
Pullups.watch: Swinging, or stopping halfway up and down.
Pullups.feel: Back and front of the arms

cues: Start from a full hang with your shoulders pulled down
Pull your chest toward the bar
Lower slowly to straight arms
Chin-Up.watch: Swinging, or cutting the bottom half short.
Chin-Up.feel: Front of the arms and back

cues: Make your body one straight line from head to heels
Screw your hands into the floor
Lower your chest to the floor and press the floor away
Pushups.watch: Sagging hips, flared elbows, or half reps.
Pushups.feel: Chest, shoulders, back of the arms
Pushups.easier: Incline push-ups with your hands on a table.

cues: Hands on something stable, body in one straight line
Lower your chest to the edge
Press away until your arms are straight
Incline Push-Up.feel: Chest, shoulders, back of the arms

cues: Squeeze your glutes and pull your belly button up
Push the floor away through your forearms
Breathe steadily; end the set when your hips sag
Plank.watch: Hips sagging, or piking up toward the ceiling.
Plank.easier: Knees down, or hands on a bench.

cues: Spread the floor apart with your feet
Sit back and down, heels flat
Stand up by pushing the floor away
Bodyweight Squat.watch: Heels lifting or knees caving in.
Bodyweight Squat.easier: Squat to a chair and stand up.

cues: Keep your body in one straight line like a plank
Pull your chest to the bar
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top
Inverted Row.watch: Hips dropping, or only pulling with your arms.
Inverted Row.feel: Back and front of the arms
Inverted Row.easier: Bend your knees, or stand more upright.

cues: Stand tall with a long stance
Lower your back knee straight down
Keep your weight on the front heel
Split Squats.watch: Leaning forward, or the front knee caving in.
Split Squats.easier: Hold a wall or post for balance.
